✨ Air Fried Crispy Corn 🌽🔥

Craving something crispy without deep frying? This Air Fryer Crispy Corn is super easy, delicious, and perfect for evening snacks! 😍

📝 Recipe:
🌽 Boil sweet corn in salted water until tender and drain well.

Add:
🧄 Garlic paste
🌶️ Red chilli powder
🌿 Coriander powder
🥄 Cornstarch
🧂 Salt
⚫ Black pepper

Mix everything until the corn is evenly coated. Spray some oil.

🔥 Air fry at 180°C for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through for even crispiness.

Finish with:
🧅 Chopped onion
🌿 Fresh coriander
🍋 A squeeze of lemon

Mix well and enjoy your crispy, flavorful corn! 🤤

💛 Save this recipe and share it with someone who loves quick and tasty snacks!
